args.body: Investigated production Sentry issue CHECKOUT-WEB-7Q (2,940 events; Android 15 / app android 8.2): PromoNotFound for code ' autumn24 '. Implemented the product + mobile agreed fix locally in checkout/promo.py: normalize_code now uses code.strip().replace(" ", "").upper() before returning the code. Added tests/test_promo.py covering the reported input, internal spaces, surrounding whitespace, already-normalized codes, empty/space-only input, punctuation preservation, and idempotency. Verification: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passed (1 test method, 7 input cases). These are local workspace changes only; no commit, PR, or production deployment has been made. The workspace has no Git repository metadata.
